Concrete correction: 
Instead of using `a.time > b.time`, you should use `a.time < b.time` to sort in descending order. This ensures that the latest timestamps are placed at the beginning of the array.

Regression example:
Before:
```typescript
rows.sort((a, b) => a.time > b.time ? 1 : -1);
```
After:
```typescript
rows.sort((a, b) => a.time < b.time ? 1 : -1);
```
This change ensures that `rows` is sorted in descending order by time, which is the intended behavior.
